title: alangium ebenaceum
intro: Alangium ebenaceum, commonly known as the "Buddha's Hand" or "Thai Buddha's Hand," is a species of plant in the family Cornaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, and has been found to possess numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alangium ebenaceum include wound healing, immune system modulation, and potential anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
